Sandbox_TWF_BF_UseTwF_SizeTables: Use Better Fishing catch chance tables
Sandbox_TWF_BF_UseTwF_SizeTables_tooltip:
Switches between the vanilla catch chance tables and the Better Fishing tables (skill size limits + distribution).
Default: enabled.
Note: This choice is applied when the world loads. Reload your save after changing it.
Sandbox_TWF_BF_AimDist_tooltip:
Maximum cast/aim distance in tiles.
Default: 16.
Sandbox_TWF_BF_ShoreRadius_tooltip:
Shore detection radius in tiles.
Lower values mean a stricter 'near shore' check.
Default: 7.
Sandbox_TWF_BF_SizeBlend_tooltip:
Near shore, this shifts the size distribution toward smaller fish.
Higher values convert more medium/large catches into small catches.
0% = off, 100% = maximum effect.
Default: 100%.
Sandbox_TWF_BF_TempCoeff_tooltip:
Applies a flat fishing modifier at all temperatures.
100% = no change.
This setting does not use temperature ranges.
Default: 100%.
Sandbox_TWF_BF_TimeCoeff_tooltip:
Catch chance multiplier during the bonus timeframes (percent).
100% = no bonus.
Default: 120%.
